10k.note: Herbalife is a global nutrition direct-sales company. The 10-K Overview describes weight management, targeted nutrition, energy/sports/fitness, and outer nutrition consumer products sold through independent Members. No proprietary therapeutic pipeline disclosed.

website.error: no public drug pipeline page — Herbalife is a consumer nutrition company

ctgov.note: Only result is NCT01030354, a UCLA-led nutrition trial completed in 2005 with Herbalife International of America as collaborator providing meal replacements. Not a Herbalife-sponsored clinical drug program.

commercial_product.note: Sold globally through independent Members across North America, Latin America, EMEA, Asia Pacific, and China.

excluded_partner_owned.reason: Investigator-initiated nutrition trial sponsored by UCLA; Herbalife was a collaborator only. Completed 2005.

no_active_clinical_pipeline_reason: Distribution / consumer nutrition company — no proprietary therapeutic clinical pipeline. Sells nutrition products through a direct-sales (multi-level marketing) Member channel.
